question: Which of the following states or UTs had the smallest population in 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **2011 Census of India**, **Lakshadweep** had the smallest population among all states and Union Territories in India.
 
• The total population of Lakshadweep was **64,473**, making it the least populated Union Territory.
 
• **Sikkim**, while being the least populated state, had a population of **610,577**, which is significantly higher than Lakshadweep.
 
• Other states such as **Mizoram** (population: 1,091,014) and **Arunachal Pradesh** (population: 1,382,611) also had larger populations compared to Lakshadweep.
 
• Lakshadweep is a group of **36 small islands** and is geographically the smallest Union Territory in India, contributing to its low population density.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep:**

 
 
• It is located in the **Arabian Sea**, off the southwestern coast of India.
 
• It consists of **36 islands**, including **10 inhabited islands**, **17 uninhabited islands**, and others comprising lagoons and reefs.
 
• The official language is **Malayalam**, and the primary occupation of the residents is fishing and coconut farming.
 
• It has a **high literacy rate** of approximately **91.85%** as per the 2011 Census.
 
• Lakshadweep is known for its **pristine beaches**, coral reefs, and marine biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Sikkim:**
 
 
• Sikkim is located in the northeastern part of India and is bordered by Bhutan, Nepal, and China.
 
• It is the **least populated state in India**, with a population of **610,577** as per the 2011 Census.
 
• Sikkim is known for its **natural beauty**, including the **Himalayan mountain ranges** and biodiversity.
 
• The state capital is **Gangtok**, and the official languages include Nepali, Lepcha, and Bhutia.
 
• Sikkim has achieved recognition for its environmental initiatives, such as being the first fully **organic state** in India.
 
 
 
• **Mizoram:**
 
 
• Mizoram is located in the northeastern region of India and is bordered by Myanmar and Bangladesh.
 
• It had a population of **1,091,014** according to the 2011 Census.
 
• The primary language spoken is **Mizo**, and agriculture is the main occupation of its residents.
 
• Mizoram is known for its **lush landscapes** and bamboo forests.
 
• The state capital is **Aizawl**.
 
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh:**
 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is the northeasternmost state of India, sharing borders with Bhutan, Myanmar, and China.
 
• It had a population of **1,382,611** as per the 2011 Census.
 
• The state is renowned for its **tribal diversity**, with over **26 major tribes** and numerous sub-tribes.
 
• The official language is **English**, and the state capital is **Itanagar**.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is rich in natural resources, including forests, rivers, and mountains.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Population Density:**

 
 
• Lakshadweep has the **lowest population** due to its small geographical size and limited inhabitable area.
 
• Among states, **Sikkim** ranks the lowest in terms of population.
 
• The population density of Lakshadweep is higher compared to some northeastern states due to its smaller land area.
 
 
 
• **2011 Census:**
 
 
• The 2011 Census provided crucial data about population distribution, density, and demographics across India.
 
• It highlighted the **diverse population** characteristics of India's states and Union Territories.
